what_this_is: Phase 2 SMALL version. Human air table from the only human songs on Steven's PC. NOT the 20-40 references from several sources that PROMPT.md asks for. That need stays OPEN.
why_small: Steven declined the ~40 GB MUSDB18-HQ download. The workspace cannot reach music sites.
source_family: Cambridge-MT multitrack library only (1 family). Test use only. Never shipped, never uploaded to the repo.
damaged_input: KarlHungus_GotYourLove.zip on Steven's PC is cut off (no end record). 15 of 18 files recovered with CRC match; files after 16_Synth01 are lost. Not a design choice.
role_map_note: Roles come from the public Cambridge-MT file names, written here before measuring. This is not the closed Suno key. Karl Hungus is a programmed (sample/808) production, not played drums: noted as 'programmed' in the table.

rules.metric: h1c.ratio_metrics over loud frames (hysteresis P70/P60, silence -80 dB). Report 5-10 kHz level, 16-20 kHz level, ratio, n frames, n loud frames. Absolute levels always shown next to the ratio.
rules.bandwidth: h1c.cutoff_audit on every file. Files whose cutoff is below 19 kHz are listed but excluded from the table (Phase 1 rule).
rules.too_quiet: Files with fewer than 20 loud frames get no ratio (Phase 1 rule).
rules.summary: Per role: n, median, min, max. A bootstrap interval is given ONLY when n >= 5, else 'no interval (n too small)'. No pooled all-roles median is claimed as a yardstick (Phase 1 lesson).
rules.no_claims: No claim about Suno versus human is made from this table. Suno comparison is a separate step after the human table is committed. The closed key stays closed.
rules.level_note: Stems are not loudness-matched; absolute levels are stem levels, not mix levels. Ratio is the comparable number; absolute levels are context.

limits: Stems are single tracks, not full mixes.
Genre spread is narrow: blues/country, rock, hip-hop/electronic-ish, programmed.
